summary: Request to run an AI-grid flood (reachability flood fill) on a level: pointer to the eoc::AiFlood result object, level name, flood flags and three integer parameters. Consumed by eoc::aigrid::FloodRequestSystem (game per-frame update bg3.exe+0xF2C0B0, ProcessNewRequests bg3.exe+0xF2C150; Toolkit EoCShared.dll+0xE4B9C0), which calls eoc::AiGrid::RequestFlood(AiFlood*, Flags<EAiFloodFlag> const&, int, int, int) and stores the returned request handle in eoc::aigrid::_private::FloodRequestStateComponent. eoc::controller::FloodComponent holds the same pointer/handle/level trio on the client. Never seen alive. Registry total 32 (client and server rows).

fields.name: Flood
fields.evidence: Game ProcessNewRequests bg3.exe+0xF2C150 (storage stride 0x20): lVar4 = *(u64*)(req+0); it writes the flood object's +0x54 (uint16 flags), +0x56 (byte 0) and +0x58 (int) and stores lVar4 into the new AiGrid request. Toolkit ProcessNewRequests passes *(req+0) as the AiFlood* argument of AiGrid::RequestFlood. macOS default: zero.

fields.name: Level
fields.evidence: Toolkit ProcessNewRequests: LevelManager::GetLevel(levelManager, (FixedString*)(req + 8)) and the assert 'Trying to request a flood on unexisting level '%s''. Game: `*(uint*)(req+8)` hashed and compared as the level-map key. macOS default stores w24 (null FixedString) at +8.

fields.name: Flags
fields.evidence: Game ProcessNewRequests copies `*(undefined2*)(req+0xC)` to AiFlood+0x54; Toolkit passes req+0xC as `ls::Flags<eoc::EAiFloodFlag,0,33> const&` to AiGrid::RequestFlood, which copies 2 bytes to AiFlood+0x54. Enum eoc::EAiFloodFlag (written as uint16). macOS default strh at +0xC.

fields.name: _PadE
fields.evidence: alignment of the int at +0x10; not read.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Game ProcessNewRequests: lVar5 = *(u64*)(req+0x10); stores (int)lVar5 (+0x10) at AiGrid request +0x14. Toolkit: passed as the first int of RequestFlood (to FUN_180e32d60). macOS default 'str d8, [+0x10]' covers +0x10..+0x17.

fields.name: field_14
fields.evidence: Game: uVar1 = *(u32*)(req+0x14) stored at AiGrid request +0x10. Toolkit: second int of RequestFlood.

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Game: iVar7 = *(int*)(req+0x18), 0x7FFFFFFF clamped to 0x7FFFFFFE, written to AiFlood+0x58 (Toolkit RequestFlood does the same with its last int) - probably a maximum distance/cost of the flood. macOS default str w8 at +0x18.

fields.name: _Pad1C
fields.evidence: padding to the 8-aligned size 0x20; not read.
